summary: Shows the any and all tests (2.4+) to check whether any or all list elements are true.
questions: How do I check if all items in a list are true?
How do I check if at least one item in a list is true?

answer_card.title: any and all tests
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
when: mylist is all        # every element true
when: myotherlist is any   # at least one true
```
